messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE German line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Ich schaute hoch und sah seine Schultern bereits mit den Strahlen des Planeten bekleidet der die Menschen geradewegs entlang jedes Weges führt.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → German)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | guardai | speaker looked upward (1st sg perfect) | **schaute** | “looked” | OK | | in | preposition marking direction “in” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (German does not need a preposition here) | | alto | “high”, destination of the look | **hoch** | “high / up” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction linking two actions | **und** | “and” | OK | | vidi | speaker saw (1st sg perfect) | **sah** | “saw” | OK | | le | definite article (fem. pl.) for “spalle” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (German omits the article) | | sue | possessive adjective referring to the antecedent entity | **seine** | “its / his” | OK | | spalle | “shoulders”, direct object of *vidi* | **Schultern** | “shoulders” | OK | | vestite | state of being clothed/covered (past participle) | **bekleidet** | “clothed / covered” | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” | **bereits** | “already” | OK | | de' | preposition + article “of the” (genitive, plural) | **der** | “of the” (genitive plural) | OK | | raggi | “rays” emitted by the planet | **Strahlen** | “rays” | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” (genitive, singular) | **des** | “of the” (genitive singular) | OK | | pianeta | “planet”, source of the rays | **Planeten** | “planet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun introducing clause about the planet | **der** | “that / who” | OK | | mena | verb “lead” (3rd sg present) | **führt** | “leads / guides” | OK | | dritto | adverb “straight, aright” | **geradewegs** | “straight, directly” | OK | | altrui | “people, men” (indirect object) | **Menschen** | “people / men” | OK | | per | preposition “along / for” | **entlang** | “along” | OK | | ogne | determiner “every” | **jedes** | “every” | OK | | calle | “path, way” (object of *per*) | **Weges** | “of the way / path” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `in`, `le` – German does not require a preposition before “hoch” nor a definite article before “Schultern”. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; all translated elements agree in gender, number, and case with the German target sentence.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only German script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final German text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 16: - Original: Ich schaute hoch und sah seine Schultern - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 17: - Original: bereits mit den Strahlen des Planeten bekleidet - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 18: - Original: der die Menschen geradewegs entlang jedes Weges führt. - Issue: GRAMMAR – incorrect case/ending after “entlang” - Corrected: der die Menschen geradewegs entlang jeden Weg führt.
